paragraphs: I love exploring. Whether I’m at my desk or traveling to a new country, I’m always eager to gain new perspectives. With experience across banking, technology, and entrepreneurship, I enjoy developing new ideas and working through unfamiliar problems. I’m driven not by my accomplishments, but rather by my intense desire to grow through challenges.
Away from the desk, I’m usually exploring new hobbies, golfing, or traveling somewhere new with a camera in hand.
